# Qamira Consulting

> Qamira Consulting is a Business Performance Excellence and AI Consulting firm for SMEs. We diagnose what's actually constraining a business's growth, redesign the process and operating model beneath it, and deploy AI-native execution to make the fix permanent -- governed by QBPES™, our proprietary performance system. We are a consulting and advisory firm, not a software vendor, marketing agency, or automation shop.

Qamira serves small-to-medium businesses ($2M-$50M revenue), post-Series A/B growth-stage startups, and enterprise divisions. Engagements start with a diagnosis, never a technology purchase.

## Core methodology

- [QBPES™ Methodology](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/methodology): The Qamira Business Performance Excellence System -- eight interdependent performance domains (Strategy, Financial Performance, Process, People, Data, Technology, Customer, Governance), a five-level maturity model, and an eight-step delivery process.
- [Qamira GrowthOS™](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/growth-os): An AI-enabled business growth and performance operating system -- QBPES™ productized specifically for growth. Connects Diagnose, Strategise, Acquire, Convert, Deliver, Measure, Optimise, and Scale into one continuous loop. It is not a CRM, chatbot, dashboard, marketing tool, automation platform, or AI video-generation service -- those are, at most, individual swappable components inside it.
- [AI Solutions](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/ai-solutions): How Qamira governs its own use of AI -- evidence-based findings, human review gates, and the Cognitive Transformation Matrix used to decide what should and shouldn't be automated.

## What we do

- [Services](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/services): Business Performance Transformation, Operational Excellence & Process Optimization, Analytics Strategy & BI Engineering, AI Strategy & Custom Agent Implementation, plus managed services and executive workshops.
- [Technology](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/technology): Productized offerings Qamira builds -- customer-facing AI (chatbots, CRM, AI receptionist and call automation), content & growth systems (AI video, scheduling, marketing automation), and internal automation & intelligence (workflow integration, knowledge agents, document extraction).
- [AI Receptionist (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/ai-receptionist): A done-for-you AI receptionist for Australian tradies, clinics and service businesses -- answers calls 24/7, books jobs, quotes from the business's own rate card, hands off to staff by callback and logs every call to the CRM.
- [Google Business Profile Optimisation (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/google-business-profile): Done-for-you Google Business Profile and local SEO setup for Australian tradies, clinics and local service businesses -- profile set up or cleaned up, categories, service areas, photos, a review request process and consistent citation listings.
- [AI & Process Consulting (Melbourne)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/ai-process-consulting-melbourne): AI and process consulting for Melbourne small businesses -- AI receptionists and chatbots, workflow automation, process reviews and local search for clinics, trades and professional firms, delivered remotely with a fixed price up front.
- [Business Consultant in Pune](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/business-consultant-pune): Business consulting for growing SMEs in Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad -- process improvement, AI automation, KPIs and systems for manufacturers, logistics firms and professional-services companies, on-site or online.
- [Custom Software (India)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/custom-software): Custom software, ERP and client portals for growing Indian businesses, with a written scope and fixed quote before work starts.
- [ERP & CRM Builds (India)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/erp-crm-development): CRM and custom ERP builds set up around how an Indian business sells and operates.
- [Business Automation (India)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/business-automation): Connects Tally, Excel, CRM and other tools so data is typed once, without a forced switch to new software.
- [Custom Software (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/custom-software): Custom software, business systems and client portals for growing Australian businesses, with a written scope and fixed quote before work starts.
- [CRM Development (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/crm-development): CRM setup or custom CRM builds around how an Australian business sells, connected to its accounting system.
- [Business Automation (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/business-automation): Connects Xero or MYOB, spreadsheets, CRM and email so data is typed once, without a forced switch to new software.
- [Website Development (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/website-development): Mobile-first websites for Australian small businesses, built to turn visitors into enquiries and bookings.
- [Custom Software (UK)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/uk/custom-software): Custom software, business systems and client portals for growing UK businesses, with a written scope and fixed quote before work starts.
- [CRM Development (UK)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/uk/crm-development): CRM setup or custom CRM builds around how a UK business sells, connected to its accounting system.
- [Business Automation (UK)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/uk/business-automation): Connects Xero, Sage or QuickBooks, spreadsheets, CRM and email so data is typed once, without a forced switch to new software.
- [Website Development (UK)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/uk/website-development): Mobile-first websites for UK small businesses, built to turn visitors into enquiries and bookings.
- [Industries](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries): Pre-built QBPES™ variants for specific verticals -- manufacturing, logistics, construction, retail, healthcare, financial services, professional services, startups, and public sector.

## Industry accelerators

Each is a pre-built QBPES™ variant for that vertical -- the same eight domains and eight-step delivery process, pre-populated with the KPIs, process taxonomies, and benchmark ranges the vertical typically needs.

- [Manufacturing](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/manufacturing): Operational OEE, supply chain logistics, demand analytics.
- [Logistics & Supply Chain](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/logistics-supply-chain): Fleet utilization, route efficiency, warehouse analytics.
- [Construction & Infrastructure](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/construction-infrastructure): Resource management, project drift tracking.
- [Retail & E-Commerce](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/retail-ecommerce): CAC/LTV models, inventory turns, customer journey.
- [Healthcare](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/healthcare): Patient flow, cost optimization, resource allocation.
- [Financial Services](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/financial-services): Risk architecture, operational throughput, executive reporting.
- [Professional Services](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/professional-services): Resource utilization, project profitability.
- [Growing Startups & Tech](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/startups-tech): Agility mapping, burn-rate optimization.
- [Public Sector & Education](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/public-sector-education): Resource allocation, compliance management.
